intro: Henchman Valik lies injured and dying in a Syndicate camp, confronted by an enemy. Certain you will kill them anyway, Valik strikes a bargain: a mug of Southshore Stout in exchange for answers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.
No doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring me something to drink or did you just come back to finish the job?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Given my impending death, I think I can safely say that this is the sweetest tasting thing ever... Here, take this, won't do me any good when I'm dead.
